title: Mbappé draws fire from right wing in France, Spain over Ceuta t-shirt controversy
summary: Real Madrid's French forward Kylian Mbappé is facing mounting criticism by Spanish and French conservative and far-right politicians for partially obscuring a t-shirt supporting residents of Ceuta, Spain's territory bordering Morocco grappling with a migration crisis.
